basis: Base FCF is filing-derived TTM operating cash flow less purchases of productive assets and is treated as FCFE / levered FCF as a research approximation; no net debt subtraction is applied. TTM equals FY2026 plus Q1 FY2027 less Q1 FY2026. Diluted shares use Q1 FY2027 weighted-average diluted shares in millions. Growth, discount-rate, and terminal-growth paths are analyst test assumptions, not company guidance.
source: NVIDIA FY2026 Form 10-K and Q1 FY2027 Form 10-Q for base inputs; scenario assumptions prepared solely for Phase 2 regression testing
